changelog: - **An inserted structure's activator reads the inserted Parameter.** An activator that compares with a Parameter, for example at least Threshold, kept the Parameter's old id when its structure was added with Insert saved structure…, so it read the document's own node of that id, or no node at all, and opened at the wrong value or never. Save selected structure… also saved such an activator without its Parameter, and saved a selection holding both as an older file version in which the comparison no longer names the Parameter. The activator now reads the inserted Parameter, a selection whose activator reads a Parameter outside it is refused with the reason, as one with a Register already was, and the file keeps the version the comparison needs.
